column1: Snippets are added, changed and switched on in Marketing › Rich Snippets. This page holds what applies to all of them at once.

column1: Choosing No stops every snippet in this scope, whatever its own switch says. Nothing is deleted.

column1: Readable adds line breaks and indentation, for reading the page source. Pages get slightly larger.

column1: The price in a snippet has to be the price the visitor sees. Change this only if the theme shows prices differently from the tax settings.

column1: The default theme and the themes built on it write their own Product markup into the product page. With a Product snippet switched on, every product would be described twice.
column2: It-tema predefinita u t-temi mibnija fuqha jiktbu l-markup tagħhom stess tal-Product fil-paġna tal-prodott. Meta Product snippet ikun attivat, kull prodott jiġi deskritt darbtejn.

column1: Remove the Theme’s Own Product Markup

Takes the schema.org attributes of the items the page’s snippets also describe, such as the product with its price and rating, out of the product page’s HTML. Other items stay. Nothing visible changes. Only on product pages that output a Product snippet.
